import-linear-programming-bc6c3bd7c4a0755c jessica prepares \(x\) g of sauce a and \(y\) g of sauce b using 110 g of vinegar, 180 g of salad cream and 300 g of ketchup. sauce a uses vinegar, salad cream and ketchup in the ratio \(1:2:2\); sauce b uses them in the ratio \(1:1:3\).

(b) represent the feasible region graphically.

(a) 列出 x、y 的所有限制。
(b) 在坐標平面上表示可行區域。
(c) 每瓶 100 g 醬汁 a 和醬汁 b 的利潤分別為 $40 和 $30。求最大利潤。 s6/linear programming/linear programming reviews.pdf · p4 · q12 s6/linear programming/linear programming reviews.pdf · p4 · q12 convert resource ratios into constraints · 配方比例轉限制
